blocks.text: Annelids ko aam taur par segmented worms (hisson mein bate keere) kehte hain. Yeh samandar mein (jaise nereis), meethe paani mein (jaise leech yani jonk) aur nam mitti mein (jaise earthworm yani kenchua) milte hain. Kuch annelids ectoparasites (jism ke bahar chipak kar rehne wale parasites) hain, jaise jonk.

Jism aar paar bohat se ek jaise hisson mein bata hota hai jinhein segments kehte hain. Andar se segments ek doosre se cross walls (septa) ke zariye alag hote hain. Har segment ke apne circulatory, excretory aur neural hisse hote hain. Jism ki is qisam ki segmentation ko metameric segmentation kehte hain. Annelids bilaterally symmetrical aur triploblastic hain; yeh protostome coelomates hain. Annelids mein khaas hisse hote hain jinhein setae kehte hain: har segment ki ventral wall mein chitin ke sakht baal (bristles). Jonk mein setae nahi hote. Body wall par epidermis ki banai hui nam, acellular (cells ke baghair) cuticle hoti hai. Digestive system tube jaisa hai; digestive tube alag alag hisson mein bati hai aur har hisse ka apna kaam hai. Parasitic annelids ka digestive system saada hota hai.
Bahar se segments jism ki satah par chhote chhallon jaisi sikurnon se nazar aate hain (“Annelid” ka matlab hai “chhota chhalla”).

blocks.alt: Kenchwe (earthworm) ki aam banawat: peechhe ka hissa poora, chhallon jaise segments, neeche setae aur sire par anus; aage ka hissa lambai mein khola gaya: septa coelom ko khanon mein baantte hain, mouth se digestive tube, us ke upar aur neeche blood vessels jo pseudohearts se jure hain, neeche nerve cord aur aage cerebral ganglion, aur har segment mein metanephridium.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Andar ki khaali jagah coelom hai jise septa (deewarein) har segment mein alag khanon mein baant deti hain; isi liye har segment mein apna metanephridium (neeli lipti nali) hai. Khoon hamesha naliyon mein rehta hai (closed system): upar ki aur neeche ki blood vessel aage ke hisse mein paanch jore pseudohearts (laal chhalle) se juri hain, jo dhadak kar khoon chalate hain. Nerve cord neeche (ventral) hai aur aage cerebral ganglion se milti hai.

Excretory system cilia wale, funnel (qeef) jaise metanephridia se bana hai; har segment mein metanephridia ka ek jora hota hai. Circulatory system closed type hai: khoon hamesha blood vessels ke andar behta hai. In mein khaas dharakne wale blood vessels hote hain jinhein pseudohearts kehte hain. Zyada tar annelids ke khoon ke plasma mein respiratory pigment haemoglobin ghula hota hai. Gases ka tabadla jild (skin) se hota hai. Aage ke segment mein cerebral ganglion ya brain hota hai, jis se ek dohri (double), lambi ventral nerve cord nikalti hai jo har segment ko nerves deti hai; har segment mein ganglia bhi hote hain. Annelids mein tactile receptors (chhoone ko mehsoos karne wale), chemoreceptors (chemicals ko), balance receptors (tawazun ko) aur photoreceptors (roshni ko) hote hain. Kuch annelids mein lens wali achhi tarah bani aankhein bhi hoti hain. Zyada tar annelids hermaphrodite hain (jaise kenchua, jonk) aur kuch unisexual (jaise nereis).
